source_conclusions: Closed root-mode validation precedes preflight; malformed-input availability remains independent of semantic success and planning prerequisite.
The pure summary preserves every supplied diagnostic index and severity count, marks FINDINGS_LIMIT incomplete, and groups exact next_action text without trimming or case folding.
Input cardinality, action text, retained rows/indices and sorting work are reserved before their corresponding retained output or bounded collection operations; failure returns no partial summary.
The builder lazily delegates one mode/kind/identifier to public report_projection and detaches the bounded report. It does not independently evaluate another rule family.

Planning requires exactly two WriteGrant values matching completion-report kind, caller ID and configured deterministic JSON/Markdown paths before generation. It derives CAS hashes only from captured files and both streams from the same report.

Existing plan_mutation owns path authorization, prospective graph/identity validation and later commit_mutation authority. The producer performs no I/O, accepts no caller-rendered bytes and mints no grants.
Legacy helpers reuse accepted bounded v1 adapters and explicitly label compatibility counts without a readiness claim; versioned render envelopes are rejected.
All three reviewed files are at most 500 lines, have typed intent contracts, and the tests use memory fixtures without filesystem/process/network work.

reused_pure_proof.qualification: This is partial producer proof: 72/95 statements and 18/24 branches, not full-module acceptance. Raw output and coverage identities remain unmodified.
